Under the renewed agreement, Analogic will continue to provide maintenance and support for BIA’s security screening equipment

Staff Writer ,  TradeArabia

Bahrain Airport Company (BAC) has announced the renewal of its partnership with Leidos Security Detection & Automation UK, a member of the Analogic group of companies, for the maintenance of security screening equipment at Bahrain International Airport. 

The announcement was made by BAC, the operating and managing body of Bahrain International Airport, on the sidelines of the Gateway Gulf 2026 event in Manama, thus reaffirming its commitment to supporting the growth of companies operating in the Kingdom’s aviation sector.

Under the renewed agreement, Analogic will continue to provide maintenance and support for BIA’s security screening equipment, helping maintain the highest standards of airport security and ensuring a smooth passenger journey through the airport.

BAC Chief Executive Officer Ahmed Mohamed Janahi said: "Effective security screening is fundamental to passenger safety and operational efficiency at Bahrain International Airport. Renewing our partnership with Analogic helps maintain the reliability and readiness of security screening equipment, supporting compliance with approved international standards and the smooth flow of airport operations."

"This collaboration also reflects our commitment to working with trusted global partners to provide passengers with a safe and seamless journey through the Kingdom’s gateway," he stated.

Gunther van Adrichem, President of Analogic’s EMEAI Region, said: "We value our partnership with BAC in security screening and technical support services, and we continue to work together to maintain the highest security standards at BIA. By leveraging advanced technologies and our specialised expertise, we are committed to enhancing the reliability and performance of screening systems, supporting BAC’s operational objectives and future growth."

The renewal underscores BAC’s commitment to maintaining world-class security standards and enhancing operational efficiency through trusted international partnerships that support a safe and seamless passenger experience, while reinforcing Bahrain International Airport’s position as the Kingdom’s gateway, placing passengers at the heart of its priorities, he added.
